name: SPL Stake Pool program (shared infrastructure)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)
the protocol's total value locked (no DefiLlama match)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Upgrades need 6 of 10 signers of a Squads v3 committee, which has no delay field, and the same program backs JitoSOL and other stake pools.
narrative.detail: Squads v3 authority index 1 of the 6-of-10 multisig, re-derived offline on every run. Jito's docs describe the upgrade keys as a committee of Solana staking ecosystem participants. Five of its ten signers are also signers of Sanctum's 6-of-11, and one key matches a Marinade council key, so cross-exposure reads low for this whole cluster.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData EmiU8A… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly)
independent_read.posture: admin: a program-derived address (not a Squads v4 vault); delay: unknown
